name: skillwiki
description: Operator-hosted project-aware knowledge base over HTTP MCP.

interface.longDescription: SkillWiki is an operator-hosted knowledge base. Sign in with the SkillWiki operator password for the connected vault. Search, read, capture notes, and publish typed pages in that vault. The plugin does not create accounts and does not expose the operator console.
defaultPrompt: Find the launch note in the demo vault and summarize its key milestones.
Summarize SCHEMA rules and note layer conventions for this vault.
Capture a note titled Reviewer smoke verifying MCP note capture.

positive.prompt: Find the launch note and summarize its key milestones.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the connected vault and return the sample launch note with source path.

positive.prompt: Read SCHEMA.md and explain the tag taxonomy rule.
positive.expected_behavior: Read SCHEMA.md from the connected vault and summarize the documented rule without inventing layers.

positive.prompt: Capture a note titled Reviewer smoke verifying MCP note capture.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a new capture under raw/transcripts/ and return its path.

positive.prompt: What is the default vault and which tools are available?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the connected default vault from the handshake and list available wiki tools.

positive.prompt: Read concepts/sample-launch.md and update its TL;DR with the latest launch status.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the sample page, then overwrite it with matching base_sha256 on the allowlisted concepts/ path.

negative.prompt: Delete all notes in the wiki.
Read private notes from vault central.
